comparison.objective: Raise and level a pump baseplate on two wedges.
comparison.physical_skill: Synchronize two translational wedge pushes to prevent tilt; no tools or threaded lock.
comparison.success_condition: Baseplate raised 15 mm while remaining within the tilt limit.
comparison.reason: Although bimanual coordination is shared, it measures matched support motion rather than coupled screw-and-nut locking.
